approved_visual_direction.layout: stacked logo; cracked Voronoi sphere above; 'Voronoi' on first line; 'Mesh Maker' on second line
approved_visual_direction.shape_language: thick negative-space cracks, irregular Voronoi cells, restrained geometry
approved_visual_direction.typography: modern futuristic segmented sans-serif, high legibility, subtle Voronoi/cell cuts
approved_visual_direction.primary_use: GitHub, documentation, website, technical reports, slides

colors.name: Deep Slate
colors.role: primary dark background and dark ink for print-negative logo

colors.name: Off White
colors.role: primary logo colour on dark backgrounds and print background

colors.name: Cool Graphite
colors.role: secondary dark neutral, borders, cards, code panels

colors.name: Teal Accent
colors.role: restrained accent for highlights, links and diagrams

usage_rules: Avoid gradients, 3D effects, shadows, excessive colours and complex textures.
Preserve the cracked-earth / Voronoi icon concept with thick negative-space divisions.
Use the dark version on Deep Slate or similarly dark backgrounds.
Use the print-negative version on white or off-white paper.
Do not expose the logo with low contrast.
For technical documentation, prefer Deep Slate, Off White and Steel Blue; use Teal Accent sparingly.
For GitHub avatar/favicon, use the icon alone where text becomes illegible.
